title: The store refuses to boot when it is newer than the build
asA: operator whose deploy rollback must never corrupt production data
iWant: the store to refuse to open when its on-disk schema version is newer than this build knows about
soThat: an accidental rollback to an older build fails loudly at boot instead of silently reading and writing against unknown schema shapes

acceptanceCriteria.description: Opening a store whose bookkeeping table records a schema version strictly greater than the build's max known migration version throws an error with a stable code and a message naming both versions; the process does not enter its request-serving state.
acceptanceCriteria.given: a store artifact whose highest bookkeeping row records version N and a build whose max known migration version is M with M < N
acceptanceCriteria.when: the boot sequence invokes the open entry point
acceptanceCriteria.then: the entry point throws an error whose code is a stable identifier for the refuse-newer condition, whose message contains both the integer N and the integer M, and the process fails to reach its request-serving state

acceptanceCriteria.description: The refuse-newer path performs no writes against the store; the bookkeeping table and every domain table are byte-identical before and after the failed open.
acceptanceCriteria.given: a store artifact snapshot taken before the failed open attempt in AC-5103-1
acceptanceCriteria.when: the failed open attempt returns control
acceptanceCriteria.then: a fresh snapshot of the same store artifact is byte-identical to the pre-attempt snapshot, and no new bookkeeping row has been written

acceptanceCriteria.description: Repeat-boot after a same-version store is a no-op that emits no migrated event. Given the store artefact on disk at exactly the build's max known version, when the process boots and closes and boots again, then each boot completes with schemaOpened but no migrated event fires; a mutation SIMULATE_DOUBLE_MIGRATE=true forces a spurious migrated event on the second boot and the sink observer FAILS with the leaked event id.
acceptanceCriteria.given: the store artefact at exactly the build's max known version
acceptanceCriteria.when: the process boots, closes, and boots again
acceptanceCriteria.then: each boot fires schemaOpened but no migrated event; the double-migrate mutation FAILS
